activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1915 as Kafka's representative Austro-Hungarian literary-activity year. Kafka was a Prague-based writer within Austria-Hungary, and The Metamorphosis was first published in 1915.

sources.citation_text: The Franz Kafka Museum timeline records the first publication of The Metamorphosis in 1915 and situates Kafka's writing life in Prague.
